## Body

Updates the 5de084c snapshot in counter-cardinality-and-byte-bounds. PR #148 at 03ba18533d267b66d666bfedddb39771535e573d closes both prior telemetry caveats: each retained address is at most 64 bytes; longer values overflow. Arbitrary service/route-refused claim names overflow unless the refusal names the seat (retired/held) or the exact address registered successfully in this daemon run. No registry read is added to justify retaining a name. Authenticated ping still exposes bounded known/legitimate historical seat identifiers, not arbitrary failed claims; do not claim zero identity visibility. Security passes at this head; correctness/performance and deferred live attribution remain separate. Linux CI green; no local builds/tests, production macOS observer source-only here, reported macOS clippy not independently rerun. Verdict: security/outputs/2026-11/07-verdict-pr-148-03ba185.dd.json.
